program.name: Tabata Ten
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: Tabata blocks (20 s on, 10 s off) followed by a kettlebell AMRAP finisher.
program.about: Tabata blocks, 20 seconds hard and 10 seconds rest, followed by a kettlebell AMRAP. Three days rotate: legs and cardio, upper and cardio, and total body. Level II adds reps and Level III moves the finisher one weight up. Short, hard sessions for conditioning.
